status: DRAFT for discussion. NOT approved, NOT executable: the ablation arms and the two-policy driver are not written. Becomes a plan only after the code exists, tests pass, the plan is regenerated by its driver and the user approves its SHA256 with a USD cap.
questions: Q1 generalisation: does the unchanged v2 keep its paired gain and zero harm with a second base policy (Vision-V1 train seed 2) and on new scenes with the first?
Q2 components: how much of the gain over v1 comes from temporal memory, as opposed to the base-camera estimator used on a single frame and to the changed abstention rules?
data_role: development. Not calibration, not Test. Pre-registered tests make it a planned development replication, not a confirmatory result under the protocol.

train_seed_1.status: selected and qualified in Vision-V1; the policy v2 was designed on

train_seed_2.status: trained in Vision-V1 run2 (same data, architecture, 80k EMA); 83/100 on vision_v1_select; not selected, never qualified, never used with any intervention

rules: no retraining, no fine-tuning, no other checkpoint
v2 constants, memory rules and abstention rules are those of the freeze manifest draft for both policies; nothing is adapted to train seed 2
a third policy seed does not exist; training one is outside this plan

scenes.use: the same 200 scenes for both policies (paired over arms within a policy; policies compared on equal scenes)
scenes.seed_level_check: PASS in Phase C0 (seed_and_split_audit.json): no overlap with any declared or used set, none named in a stored record
scenes.placement_check: first server step; identical initial cube placement against every placement on record fails the step; the set is then not used and not patched silently
scenes.final: the registry file is written and hashed only after the user confirms the range

arms.VISION_CENTER_V1: unchanged single-frame baseline (v1 rules, hand camera at the trigger)
arms.V2_SINGLE_FRAME: v2 decision rules and both v2 estimators, but only the observation of the trigger step: hand-camera fit, else the base-camera estimate of that one frame (no confirmation count possible, so confirm_min = 1 for this arm only), held-cube fit of that frame only. No history. This is "v2 without temporal memory": v2 minus this arm = the effect of memory; this arm minus v1 = the effect of the base-camera estimator on one frame plus the changed rules
arms.V2_NO_HAND_MEMORY: tier 2, leave one out: full v2 with remembered hand-camera target fits disabled
arms.V2_NO_BASE_MEMORY: tier 2, leave one out: full v2 with base-camera observations disabled
arms.V2_NO_HOLD_MEMORY: tier 2, leave one out: full v2 with the remembered held-cube fit disabled
arms.V2_RULES_OFF: tier 2: full v2 memory with the v2-only abstention rules removed (uncertainty margin, side-contact rule, memory height rule; the v1 rules stay). Measures what the rules cost and what they prevent. May harm; development simulation only
arms.implementation: new module and driver that import hci.vision_center_v2 and switch components by arguments; hci.vision_center_v2 itself is not edited (its hash stays ab548ccc...). A test must show that the arm with nothing switched off reproduces VISION_CENTER_V2 decisions on the stored frames of all 500 used scenes

tier_0_free_local: before any paid step: replay every arm's DECISION (act / abstain, source, estimate) on the stored frames of the 500 used scenes 50600-51099, CPU only, no simulator. Development only; it shows which arms ever decide differently. An arm that never differs from another on 500 scenes can be dropped from the paid run before the plan is frozen

per_policy: success of every arm with Wilson interval
paired v2 against C0: rescue, harm, net, Tango score interval, exact one-sided paired test
paired v2 against v1 and v2 against V2_SINGLE_FRAME: same
harm: count, n+, one-sided 95 % Clopper-Pearson upper limit; also among scenes where the arm acted
memory errors, target pushed, unnecessary acts, abstentions by reason, oracle recovery
primary_tests: H_gen: v2 beats C0 with train seed 2 (exact one-sided paired test, alpha 0.025)
H_mem: v2 beats V2_SINGLE_FRAME, both policies pooled by scene pair, stratified by policy (exact one-sided test on the pooled discordant pairs, alpha 0.025)
analysis_pre_registered.multiplicity: Holm over the two primary tests; everything else descriptive
between_policies: difference of net gain between the two policies on the same scenes with a scene-bootstrap interval
homogeneity of the rescue odds (exact test on the two 2x2 discordant tables)
with two policy seeds the between-seed variance has one degree of freedom: reported as a range, not as a variance estimate

safety_stop_criteria_fixed_in_advance.note: proposed; reported as met / not met, no re-run and no tuning either way

timing_basis.host: Vast machine 146456, RTX 4090, Ryzen 7 7800X3D, US$0.4604/h, thread limit 1

cost.storage_note: frames of both cameras up to the trigger for 400 scene runs plus control frames of up to 7 vision arms; the download adds the per-GB transfer price
cost.not_included: setup, install and download are in the expected total (about 25 + 15 minutes); a discarded host as in Phase B would add about US$0.05

technical_stop_conditions: plan hash, code hashes, both policy weight hashes or the seed registry differ from the plan
CUDA / Vulkan check fails (host with driver below the CUDA 12.4 requirement: discard the host, no scene run)
an identical initial placement is found for a new seed
the restored runtime differs from the snapshot, C0 or an abstaining arm does not reproduce the trunk
ground truth reaches a vision arm (oracle read counter)
the full-v2 arm of the new driver differs from hci.vision_center_v2 on the audit scenes
the budget projection exceeds the cap before a stage or after its first five scenes: the stage does not start or stops; scenes and arms are never reduced
a ledger for the set already exists (no resume, no second pass)
any error in a scene: the pass stays INCOMPLETE, no scene dropped or replaced, no summary of a partial run
not_in_this_plan: any change of v2 constants or rules
the proposed safety variant v2s (a separate candidate with its own plan)
peg insertion or any other task
needed_from_the_user: confirm the two primary tests and the safety criteria
a USD cap and approval of the SHA256 of the plan the driver will generate (not of this draft)
